verses.en: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.sm: O LE afioga na fetalai mai aigQ ieova ia Papelonia ma le nuu o Kaletaia, na aumaia e le perofeta o Ieremia.

verses.en: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
verses.sm: Ina ta‘u atu ia outou i atu nuu, ma faailoa atu ai; sii i luga foi le tagavai; ina faailoa atu ia,aua le natia ; ia outou faapea atu, Ua aea Papelonia, ua faamaina Pele, ua matautuia Merota ; ua faamaina ona tupua, ua matautuia ana tupua.

verses.en: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
verses.sm: Auā e alu ae e tau ma ia le nuu ai le itu i matu, o le na te faia lona laueleele ma faatafunaga, e leai foi se nofo ai; ua sosola tagata atoa ma manu, ua latou ō.

verses.en: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.
verses.sm: O na ona po, ma lena tausaga, ua fetalai mai Ieova, e o mai ai le fanauga a Isaraelu, o i latou ma le fanauga a Iuta faatasi, latou te fetagisi fano mai; latou te o ane, ma saili ia Ieova lo latou Atua.

verses.en: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
verses.sm: Latou te fesili i le ala i Siona, o faasaga mai iinei o latou mata, ua faapea, Ina o mai ia, se‘i faatasi atu i tatou ia Ieova i le feagaiga e faavavau, e le galo lava.

verses.en: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
verses.sm: O lo‘u nuu ua se lafu mamoe ua se i latou; ua faaseseina i latou e o latou leoleo, ma latou faaliliuina i latou i le atu mauga; ua latou feoai i lea mauga ma lea mauga, ua galo ia i latou le mea sa latou taooto ai.

verses.en: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
verses.sm: O i latou uma na maua i latou, ua latou ‘aina i latou; na fai ane foi o e na saua mai ia te i latou, Matou te le nofo sala, auā ua latou agasala ia Ieova, o le mea e mau ai le amiotonu, o Ieova, o le faamoemoe o latou tamā.

verses.en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
verses.sm: Ina sosola ia ai totonu o Papelonia, ma o atu ia nai le laueleele o Kaletaia; ia outou faapei o ‘oti poa i luma o le lafu.

verses.en: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
verses.sm: Auā faauta, ou te faaosoina, ma aveina ae le faapotopotoga o atu nuu tetele mai le nuu i le itu i matu, e tau ma Papelonia ; latou te sauniuni e tait ma ia ; e aea foi o ia ai lena mea; o a latou u fanafana e pei o u fanafana a le toa poto; ua le foi fua mai.

verses.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: E fai foi Kaletaia ma vete; e malilie atoa uma o e vetea o ia, ua fetalai mai ai Ieova.

verses.en: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
verses.sm: Auāna outou fiafia, auā na outou olioli, o outou na vetea lo‘u tofi; auā ua outou osooso e pei o le povi fafine i le vao, ma outou tagi e pei o solofanua malolosi;

verses.en: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.sm: e matuā ma lo outou tinā;. e masiasi lava le na fanauina outou; faauta, e fai le nuu aupito mulimuli ma vao lafulafua ma nuu naumati, ma toafa.

verses.en: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
verses.sm: E le āina ia ona o le toasa o Ieova, a e faatafunaina uma lava; o i latou uma o e ui ane i Papelonia e taitasi ma ofo, ma uisa i ona mala uma.

verses.en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.
verses.sm: Ina sauniuni ia outou e tau ma Papelonia i ona itu uma; o outou uma o e lolo‘u aufana, ina fanafāna atu ia ia te ia, aua ne‘i tuu ni u fanafana; auā ua na agasala ia Ieova.

verses.en: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
verses.sm: Ia outou alalaga ia te ia i ona itu uma ; ua na tuuina mai lona lima ; ua pauu ona faavae, ua soloia ona pa; auā o le taui ma sui lenei a Ieova ; ia outou taui atu ia te ia ; e pei ona faia e ia, ia faapea ona outou faia ia te ia.

verses.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
verses.sm: Ia vavaeeseina i Papelonia le lulu saito, atoa foi ma le tago i le selesaito, i ona po o le seleselega ; latoute taitasi ma liliu i lona lava nuu, latou te taitasi foi ma sola i lona lava laueleele, ai luma o le pelu saua.

verses.en: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
verses.sm: O Isaraelu o le lafu mamoe o ia ua faataapeapeina; ua tulia o ia e leona ; o le na muai ‘ai ia te ia, o le tupu o Asuria lea ; a o le mulimuli, o lenei tupu o Papelonia o Nepukanesa lea, ua pagugu e ia ona ivi..

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.sm: O le mea lea o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o Ieova o ‘au, le Atua o Isaraelu, Faauta, ou te taui atu i le tupu o Papelonia ma lona nuu, e pei ona ou taui atu i le tupu o Asuria.

verses.en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.sm: Ou te faafoisia Isaraelu i le mea na ia mau ai; e ‘ai o ia i Karamelu ma Vasana, e ma‘ona foi o ia i le mauga o Efaraima ma Kiliata.

verses.en: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
verses.sm: O na ona po, ma lena tausaga, ua fetalai mai Ieova, e sailia ai le amioletonu a Isaraelu, a e leai; e sailia foi agasala a Iuta, a e le maua ; auā ou te faamagaloina atu ia te i latou o e ua faatotoeina e a‘u.

verses.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
verses.sm: Ina alu ae ia i le nuu o Merataimo e tau ma ia, ma e o nonofo i Pekota ; ia e faatafunaina ma matuā faaumatia o mulimuli atu ia te i latou, ua fetalai mai ai Ieova; ia e fa'a foi i ai e tusa ma mea uma na ou fai atu ai ia te oe.

verses.en: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
verses.sm: O loo i le nuu le vāvāō o le taua, ma le olopalaina e tele.

verses.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
verses.sm: E ! ua gauia ma nutililiia le samala o le lalolagi uma. E ! ua avea Papelonia ma mea e ofo ai i atu nuu.

verses.en: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.
verses.sm: Papelonia e, ua ou tuu le mailei mo oe, ua maua ai oe, a ua e le iloa ; ua maua oe, ua puea foi, auā na e sii le taua ia Ieova.

verses.en: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.sm: Ua tatalaina e Ieova lana mea e teu ai auupega, ua na au mai ai auupega o lona toasa ; auā o le galuega lena ua i le Alii o Ieova o ‘au i le nuu o Kaletaia.

verses.en: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
verses.sm: Ina o mai ia ia te ia ai mea aupito mamao, ina tatalaina ia ona fale e tuu ai mea e ‘āi; ia outou faafaupue ia te ia ia pei o faupuegāsaito, ma matuā faaumatia o ia ; aua ne‘i ai se mea e totoe ia te ia.

verses.en: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
verses.sm: Ina faaumatia ia o ana povi poa taanoa uma, ia latou o ifo ia fasia; oi talofa ia te i latou ! auā ua oo mai lo latou aso,

verses.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.sm: o ona po e tauia ai i latou. O le alaga o e ua sosola ma ua sao ai le nuu o Papelonia, e ta‘u atu i Siona le taui ma sui a Ieova lo tatou Atua, o le taui ma sui ona o lona malumalu.

verses.en: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.sm: Ia faalaei ‘au i e fanafana u e tau ma Papelonia, o i latou uma o e lolo‘u le aufana; ia outou to lauapi e vagavagai ia te ia, aua ne‘i ai se sao ; ia outou taui atu. ia te ia e tusa ma ana galuega; e pei o mea uma na ia faia, ia faapea ona outou faia ia te ia ; auā ua faamaualuga o ia ia ieova, le Paia o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e pauu ai o ona taulelea i ona malae, e fano foi i lea lava aso ona tagata tau uma, ua fetalai mai ai Ieova.

w.en: in that in the very day

verses.en: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.
verses.sm: O oe na le ua faamaualuga, faauta, ou te faia oe mo‘u fili, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, o Ieova o ‘au; auā ua oo mai lou aso, o ona po ou te taui atu ai ia te oe.

verses.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
verses.sm: E tausuai ma paū le ua faamaualuga, e leai foi se na te faatulai ia te ia ; ou te faamuina le afi i ona aai, e susunuina ai ona itu uma.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o Ieova o ‘au, Na sauaina faatasi le fanauga a Isaraelu ma le fanauga a Iuta; o i latou uma e na avea i latou o tagata o taua na latou taofi mau ia te i latou; ua latou le mafafai ona tuuina i latou ia ō.

verses.en: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.sm: E malosi le na te togiolaina i latou, o Ieova o ‘au o lona suafa lea; e matuā faia e ia la latou finauga, ina ia faanofofilemuina e ia le lalolagi, ia faagateteina foi e o nonofo i Papelonia.

w.en: which is the is his name.

verses.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai Ieova, E oo le pelu ia Kaletaia, ma e nonofo i Papelonia, ma ona alii, ma ona tagata popoto.

verses.en: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
verses.sm: O le pelu i e pepelo, e faavālea foi i latou ; o le pelu i ona toa, e matatau ai foi i latou.

verses.en: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
verses.sm: O le pelu i ana solofanua, ma ona kariota, ma tagata eseese uma ua i totonu ia te ia; e avea foi i latou ma fafine; o le pelu i ana oloa,

verses.en: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
verses.sm: e vetea foi ia. E oo le vevela i lona vai, ona mate ai lea ; auā o le nuu lava lea o tupua ua ta, ua latou mitamita vale foi i mea matautia.

verses.en: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e nonofo ai manu feai o le vao, faatasi ma aie, e mau ai foi iaena; e le toe āina e faavavau ; e le mau ai lava se tasi i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga.

verses.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
verses.sm: E pei o le faaumatia e le Atua o Sotoma ma Komoro, ma e na latou tuaoi, o loo fetalai mai ai ieova, e le nofo ai se tasi, e le mau ai foi se atalii o se tagata.

verses.en: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.sm: Faauta, e o mai le nuu ai le itu i matu, o le nuu tele ; e faaosoina foi tupu e toatele ai tuluiga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.sm: Latou te ‘u‘u le aufana ma le tao ; ua saua i latou, ma latou le alolofa ; e taalili o latou leo e pei o le sami, ua latou tietie i solofanua, o sauniuni e pei o tagata e ō i le taua, ina ia tau ma oe, le tama fafine a Papelonia.

verses.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo le tupu o Papelonia i le tala ia te i latou, ona vaivai ai lea o ona lima; ua maua foi o ia i le puapuaga, o le tiga foi e pei o se fafine o le a fanau.

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.sm: Faauta, e alu ae o ia e pei o le leona ai le matagofie o Ioritana, i le mea malosi e mau ai; a e ou te faaoso ia te i latou ia faavave ona o ese ia te ia, e pei o le emo o le mata; o ai foi le tagata filifilia ou te tofia e tau ma ia ? auā po o ai ea e tusa ma a‘u ? o ai foi e atofa 'ni aso ia te au ? o ai foi lena leoleo mamoe e mafai ona tu i o‘u luma ?

verses.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ia outou faalogologo mai ai i le pule a Ieova ua ia pule ai ia Papelonia, ma ona ma« faufauga ua ia mafaufau ai ia leaga ai le nuu o Kaletaia, E moni, e tosina i latou e le aupito itiiti o le lafu mamoe ; e moni, na te faatafunaina i o latou luga le mea e mau ai.

verses.en: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.sm: O le taalili ina ua maua Papelonia, ua luluina ai le lalolagi, ua lagona foi le alaga i nuu ese. O isi upu i le malaia a oo i Papelonia,
